newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share prices slightly off at close.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share prices slightly off at close.

text.p: Jakarta share prices edged down at the close on Tuesday on continued profit-taking amid weak market sentiment, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index was off 0.12 points, or 0.02 percent, to close at 687.93 points after touching an intra-day high of 691.88 points.
Losers led gainers by 75 to 63, with 52 counters unchanged.

"Jakarta is likely to remain directionless on Wednesday, if regional markets fail to provide any fresh leads," a broker with foreign firm said, adding that Tuesday's sluggish trade was in line with the generally weak regional markets.
But other broker said the index could move higher on possible continued foreign buying in blue chips such as noodle maker Indofood, cement producer Semen Cibinong and cigarette maker Sampoerna.
Brokers said the market shrugged off rumours that President Suharto was ill. Palace sources denied the rumours.
The sources said Suharto had visited retired army general Abdul Harris Nasution, who was recuperating in a Jakarta military hospital after minor surgery.
Indofood rose 200 rupiah to 5,600 on 2.9 million shares on talk it might post a better-than-expected 1996 net profit.

Conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers was the most active stock on what brokers said was linked to news reports its telecommunication unit has secured a 471.82-billion rupiah off-shore loan to finance its expansion in Jakarta.

Property and hotel firm Jakarta International Hotels Development was active on news it was planning a road show, brokers said. A company official said on Tuesday it plans to hold a road show in April to promote its 500 billion rupiah bonds issue. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
